newsitem.title: UK: Sterling extends losses in late European trading.
newsitem.headline: Sterling extends losses in late European trading.

text.p: 1548 GMT - Sterling down three pfennigs and almost two cents on the day after heavy cable and sterling/mark sales, mainly out of the U.S., pound also under pressure against yen and Swiss franc.
* Stops triggered on cable at $1.6280, further stops seen at $1.6200 and around key support at $1.6180.

* Political uncertainty back on the agenda after two conflicting opinion polls released today - one showing sharp drop in Labour party's lead, the other increasing its advantage over ruling Conservatives.
* ICM poll in the Guardian showed Labour's lead slumped to five points from 14, while rolling Gallup poll in Daily Telegraph put Labour 21 points ahead, up five in a week.
CBI quarterly industrial trends survey underlines problems of strong pound for exporters, showing largest fall in exporters orders since late 1993.
* Manufacturing orders at highest growth rate for two years over the four months to April, CBI says.

* Sterling/mark at 2.7745/55 marks, down from 2.8050/60 in late European trading on Tuesday. Cable at $1.6204/14 vs $1.6365/75 at previous European close. Stg/yen at 204.27/57 vs 206.40. Trade-weighted index closes at 99.3 vs 100.1.
